method.flow: Original USGS 00060 daily mean, statistic 00003; all 365 original 2023 records approved
method.decimal_sum: Exact original decimal discharge summed as safe integers before conversion
method.volume: Original daily mean * 86400 nominal reporting seconds * 0.028316846592 cubic metres per cubic foot
method.quantiles: Linear interpolation at(n-1)*p; annual thresholds reused in both reporting scopes
method.high_flow_spell: Consecutive calendar days at or above the annual 95th percentile; no event separation inference
method.sampling: Exact original calendar dates; each cohort visit date counted once across stations
method.volume_coverage: Gauge volume occurring on sampled calendar days; distinct from the fraction of water or constituent mass sampled
